summary_en: Takeuchi authorized acquisition of up to 2.2 million shares (4.8% of shares outstanding excluding treasury stock) for a maximum of 15.0 billion yen from October 14, 2026 through February 19, 2027 to enhance shareholder returns under the current shareholder return policy.
title_en: Notice regarding Determination of Matters concerning Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On October 13, 2026, Takeuchi Manufacturing's board of directors authorized the acquisition of up to 2.2 million shares of the company's common stock, representing 4.8% of shares outstanding (excluding treasury stock as of September 30, 2026). The maximum purchase price is set at 15.0 billion yen. The acquisition period runs from October 14, 2026 through February 19, 2027.

The company stated that the buyback is being undertaken to enhance shareholder returns under its current shareholder return policy, taking into account stock price levels and capital efficiency. As of the announcement date, Takeuchi held 46.3 million shares outstanding (excluding treasury stock) and 2.7 million treasury shares, not including shares held by the executive compensation BIP trust arrangement.
